caption: The drawing depicts a sculpted relief of an animal's face, resembling a feline, centered on a pale, square background. The face is primarily gray, with shading and contouring that accentuates its three-dimensional form. The eyes are prominent, almond-shaped, and colored a bright yellow-orange with dark pupils, outlined by brownish lines. Both ears, positioned at the upper corners of the head, display a yellowish hue in their interiors, bordered by gray. The whiskers are dark, drawn with thick black lines extending from either side of the snout toward the edges of the face. Two round, reddish-brown rivet-like shapes appear at both upper corners outside the ears, possibly indicating attachment points. There is a small patch of purple on the left forehead of the face. The overall color palette consists of muted grays, yellows, browns, and black accents. The background remains unadorned and off-white.
title: Cat's Head
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
